{{Commons category|Genetic engineering}}
Articles relating to [[genetic engineering]], the direct manipulation of an organism's [[gene]]s using [[biotechnology]]. It is a set of [[Genetic engineering techniques|technologies]] used to change the genetic makeup of cells, including the transfer of genes within and across species boundaries to produce improved or novel [[organisms]]. New [[DNA]] is obtained by either isolating and copying the genetic material of interest using [[recombinant DNA]] methods or by [[Artificial gene synthesis|artificially synthesising]] the DNA.
